chunks: Indeed this Qur'an explains to the children of Israel much of what they are at variance.
ai.seo_question: What does the Qur'an explain to the Children of Israel regarding their differences?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Qur'an's role as a comprehensive guide that resolves the specific theological and historical disputes of the Children of Israel, serving as a precursor to resolving broader human differences. It highlights the narrative function of the Qur'an not merely as history, but as a clarifying authority that addresses the root causes of division among previous communities.
